sections.heading: Do British citizens need a Pakistan visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Pakistan, applied for online through Pakistan's official online visa system.

sections.heading: Pakistan visa for other passport holders
sections.text: British citizens of Pakistani origin may be able to use a NICOP or POC card instead of a visa. UK residents on other passports apply online, unless their nationality has different rules.

sections.heading: NICOP and POC cards
sections.text: If you're of Pakistani origin, a NICOP (National Identity Card for Overseas Pakistanis) or POC (Pakistan Origin Card) lets you visit without a visa. We can tell you whether one suits you better than a visa.

sections.heading: Before you travel to Pakistan
sections.text: Read the UK government travel advice, as it advises against travel to some areas of Pakistan.

sections.heading: Pakistan visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Pakistan visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Pakistan.

faqs.q: Do British citizens need a visa for Pakistan?
faqs.a: Yes, unless you hold a NICOP or POC card. Visas are applied for online.

faqs.q: Can I visit Pakistan with a NICOP?
faqs.a: Yes. A NICOP or POC card lets people of Pakistani origin visit without a visa.

faqs.q: How long does a Pakistan visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
